clips.title: The story
paras: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Durnan Furcutter outfits young dwarves and gnomes. He works inside the settlement as a clothier and leather merchant, selling light attire for the mountain cold.

Inside Anvilmar, young dwarves and exiled gnomes prove themselves, and some need more freedom of movement than heavy iron allows. Durnan Furcutter sells light, pliable layers to scouts, rogues, and spellcasters who want to stay agile in Dun Morogh's bitter winds. He works near Anvilmar's hearth, offering everyday tailoring and stitched leather. He claims his stock is the finest in the valley.

Durnan appreciates a strong drink as much as an honest trade. To warm himself against the freezing draft, he orders steaming mugs of Scalding Mornbrew from Nori Pridedrift, who sells the brew piping hot across Coldridge Valley. Adventurers running errands in the valley often hurry a hot mug to Durnan before it cools, then carry the empty back to Nori.
